post_primary: Hit a Claude Code or Codex quota wall mid-session? Agent Rotate is a local router that keeps your native CLI session open and retries the quota-rejected request on another of your own accounts, same provider, before any response lands. Public repo: https://github.com/davefmurray/agent-rotate
post_alternate: Same session. Same model. Same approvals. Agent Rotate is a local router for native Claude Code and Codex. When one of your accounts gets a quota rejection, the request moves to another eligible account you own on the same provider. No partial replay. https://github.com/davefmurray/agent-rotate
cta_main_line: Local quota failover for native Claude Code and Codex
cta_small_line: Sample dashboard data shown. Tested with injected 429s and real fallback inference; natural quota exhaustion not yet verified.
